meaning.evidence: In the enlarged-vector panel the disc encloses two diagonals converging to a central vertical stem crossed by two full-width horizontal bars (a Y with double crossbar), not an S, C/E-form, or W. The 16px samples confirm both bars survive: row 8 and row 10 each read 74,0,0,0,0,74 across x=5-10 with row 9 white except the stem at x=7,8 (127,127).
meaning.treatment: None; no defect observed. The ring stays closed and the glyph keeps a white gap from it at 1x (row 8: x=2-4 and x=11-13 read 73/255/255 and 255/255/71).
